description:
I spent years on the truck, and the same house fires kept repeating — small, preventable things people leave running while they sleep.

This channel is for whoever checks the house before everyone turns in. Every week I walk you through one hazard hiding in an ordinary home — power strips, space heaters, chargers, old wiring — what makes it dangerous, and the two-minute fix that costs you nothing.

No fear-mongering. No upsells you don't need. Just a second set of eyes on your house.

10 Things a Firefighter Would NEVER Plug Into a Power Strip
